ctx.title: Charmed By A Southern Monster: Release Date Date & All We Know About Bravo’s First Scripted Microdrama Starring Craig Conover
ctx.summary:
Craig Conover is about to cause more drama, but this time the fictional kind, with his new microdrama series with Bravo. Read on for more. 
 The post  Charmed By A Southern Monster: Release Date Date & All We Know About Bravo’s First Scripted Microdrama Starring Craig Conover  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Bravo may be known for its entertaining reality series slate over decades, but that doesn’t mean that’s the lane the network will stay in forever. Now it seems like the channel is ready to venture into fictional storytelling with its first original scripted microdrama. Officially titled, Charmed by a Southern Monster, their mini-show is ready for release soon. Here’s all we know.
Charmed by a Southern Monster is all set to premiere on November 9, 2026. It stars Southern Charm star Craig Conover as Hunter Caldwell, with Nicole Mattox joining him as co-lead, playing Maeve Marchant. The fictional microdrama show was announced during this year’s awaited Bravo Fest .
🚨BREAKING FROM #BRAVOFANFEST 🚨 Allow us to set the scene… Craig Conover stars in an all-new original scripted microdrama, Charmed by a Southern Monster! Stream November 9th on the @Peacock mobile app. #SouthernCharm pic.twitter.com/QpzjT0YE2X
Even though Charmed by a Southern Monster is produced by Bravo TV, it will not air on the network. The series will be available to stream exclusively on the Peacock app from Monday, November 9, 2026. The total number of episodes expected to be released has not been confirmed by Bravo yet.
As for what to expect from the mini-show, Craig promised lots of “drama, lies, danger” and “a ton of romance.” A first look of the show was revealed during Bravo Fest, which showed the main characters interacting with each other. The short clip showed Maeve calling Hunter “the town murderer.”
She wondered why he had “the most beautiful garden” and then spotted some paperwork in a trash can. She then spotted Hunter chopping wood and recognized him. Between flashes, she tried to talk to him, only to see him move towards her, as she backed away, in fear of getting killed by him.
🚨BREAKING FROM #BRAVOFANFEST 🚨 We’re flipping the script in Charleston. Craig Conover stars in an all-new original scripted microdrama, Charmed by a Southern Monster! Stream November 9th on the @Peacock mobile app. pic.twitter.com/P84V9JyDgV
As per the synopsis, “The story follows Maeve, a brilliant corporate fixer sent to convince and seduce Hunter, a rumored murderer, into selling his family’s estate.” But then she “discovers that the town’s most feared man may actually be its most misunderstood.” How will she deal with this?
Even more so when he is “the only person who can protect her from her dangerous ex-boyfriend.” When “Maeve becomes entangled in Hunter’s world,” she is forced to confront her past and decide what she is willing to risk as family secrets and development deals threaten their connection.
